name: Minjee Park
source:
She likes to dance. She is friendly, talkative and approachable. She has been Daeshim's girlfriend since high school.

She was once a trainee for a well-known KPOP agency but was kicked out due to a breach of contract.

She is the middle child of 3 siblings. She used to work as a part-timer for a famous restaurant chain.
